subject: Invoice shows charges despite PLG credits - VAT clarification

We signed up last week through the PLG flow and the account shows a €500 promotional credit in the UI. However our March invoice (attached) still shows usage charges of €360 plus €72 VAT. Can you confirm whether the promo credit should have offset this invoice? We didn't expect any charges during the initial credits.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-17T10:05:00+01:00
Subject: FW: Charges on invoice despite PLG credits — request for credit note and VAT handling

Hi Neha / Laura,

Forwarding a customer issue — Acme EU (ACME-EU-8421) shows a €500 promotional credit in the console but they were still invoiced for €360 + €72 VAT (INV-2026-6789). They signed up via PLG and did not enter a code. Attachments from customer included.

Proposed resolution (please advise if any constraints):
- Issue a promotional credit equal to the net usage (€360) and apply to the account so the invoice balance becomes €0.
- Create a credit note for the VAT portion (€72) so they receive a refund or adjustment on the invoice, depending on EU VAT treatment.
- Add a 30-day trial extension to make sure they can complete evaluation without unexpected charges.

If you approve, I'll trigger the credit in billing and confirm with the customer. If we need accounting to issue a formal credit note, please confirm wording and whether we should void the original invoice or post a correction invoice.

Thanks — urgent on timeline, the customer is concerned.

Best,
Soojin

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-17T12:37:00+01:00
Subject: Re: FW: Charges on invoice despite PLG credits — request for credit note and VAT handling

Hi team,

Thanks for the context. A few clarifications before we proceed:
1) Is the €72 VAT posted on the invoice as a separate line? (looks like it from the attached PDF)
2) Do we have Acme's VAT ID on file? If they are VAT-registered in their country and provided us a valid VAT ID, we may be able to issue a corrected invoice net of VAT. If not, we will need to issue a credit note and refund the VAT amount.

Operationally I propose:
- Issue a promotional ledger credit for €360 to zero out usage. (This is straightforward and can be done immediately.)
- Create a credit note for €72 referencing INV-2026-6789. Accounting will process the refund to the original payment method or apply it to the next invoice based on Acme's preference.

I approve the promotional credit immediately. For the VAT credit note, I need confirmation of the VAT ID and whether Acme prefers refund vs. apply-on-next-invoice. Also please log the HubSpot deal so Finance has an audit trail.

Neha Kapoor
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-17T14:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: FW: Charges on invoice despite PLG credits — request for credit note and VAT handling

Thanks — I approve issuing up to €2,000 in promotional credits for this account to preserve the relationship. Please proceed with Neha's recommended path: promotional ledger credit of €360 now, create credit note for €72, and offer a 30‑day trial extension as a gesture.

Soojin, please confirm when the credit is posted and close the loop with the customer. Also add a short note to the HubSpot deal about the VAT credit note for the audit.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, EMEA | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-18T15:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Charges on invoice despite PLG credits — resolution plan

Hi Andrew — thanks again for your patience. Quick update and next steps: 

What we did:
- Posted a promotional ledger credit of €360 to your account (ACME-EU-8421) which offsets INV-2026-6789. You should now see a zero balance on that invoice in the console.
- Created a credit note for the VAT amount (€72) referencing INV-2026-6789. Our Finance team will process this as a refund to the original payment method unless you prefer it applied to your next invoice.
- Extended your evaluation by 30 days (trial end date now: 2026-04-16).

Reference: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-PLG-01
Attachments: invoice_6789.pdf (original) is on file.

If you can confirm whether you prefer the VAT credit as a refund or applied to the next invoice, we'll take care of it today.

Apologies for the unexpected charge — we'll add a quick internal note to ensure PLG auto-credits are applied before invoices are generated going forward.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
